jobs.title: Data Product Manager – Analytical Data Products
jobs.description:
About ShyftLabs

ShyftLabs is a fast-growing data and AI company that helps organizations unlock the value of their data through modern engineering, analytics, and intelligent products. We partner with Fortune 500 organizations to build scalable cloud solutions, AI-driven platforms, and innovative data products that accelerate business outcomes.

We're looking for a Data Product Manager to join our growing Data Products team. This role is ideal for someone who combines strong product management expertise with a deep understanding of modern data platforms and enjoys partnering directly with clients to translate complex business challenges into scalable analytical solutions.

Reporting to the Director of Analytical Data Products , you'll own the strategy, roadmap, and execution for a portfolio of analytical data products while serving as the primary point of contact for client stakeholders. You'll collaborate closely with engineering, analytics, and architecture teams to deliver high-quality, reusable data products that drive measurable business value.
What You'll Do
Product Strategy & Ownership

- Own the end-to-end lifecycle of analytical data products, from discovery and roadmap planning through delivery, adoption, and continuous improvement.

- Define product vision and priorities aligned with client business objectives and organizational strategy.

- Balance new feature development with technical debt reduction, platform scalability, and long-term product sustainability.

- Monitor product performance and usage metrics to identify opportunities for optimization and future enhancements.

Client Partnership

- Serve as the primary client-facing product lead throughout product delivery.

- Lead discovery workshops, requirements gathering sessions, and solution scoping discussions.

- Translate business objectives into clear product requirements and prioritized development backlogs.

- Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders by communicating technical concepts in a clear, business-focused manner.

- Manage stakeholder expectations while balancing competing priorities across multiple initiatives.

Product Delivery

- Maintain, prioritize, and refine product backlogs based on evolving business needs.

- Partner closely with Engineering, Analytics, Architecture, and Data teams to deliver scalable analytical data products.

- Lead Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, stand-ups, retrospectives, and release planning.

- Ensure successful product launches and ongoing operational excellence.

Data & Technical Leadership

- Collaborate with engineering teams to define data quality, governance, testing, and usability standards.

- Contribute to architectural discussions involving modern data platforms including Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, and similar technologies.

- Advocate for reusable, scalable data products using modern architectural principles including Data Mesh, Data Fabric, Semantic Layer, and FAIR principles.

- Perform hands-on SQL analysis and data validation when necessary to support product decisions and client discussions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Partner with Legal, Privacy, Compliance, and Security teams to ensure products meet regulatory and governance requirements.

- Work closely with executive stakeholders to communicate product strategy, delivery progress, and technical tradeoffs.

- Foster a product-led culture focused on delivering measurable business value through data.
What You Bring
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Business, Engineering, or a related discipline.

- 3–5+ years of experience in Product Management, Data Product Management, Data Management, Analytics, or Data Science.

- Proven experience managing the full product lifecycle from discovery through launch and continuous improvement.

- Strong client-facing experience with the ability to gather requirements, influence stakeholders, and manage expectations.

- Advanced SQL skills with the ability to analyze datasets and validate business hypotheses.

- Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, BigQuery, ClickHouse, Databricks, Redshift, or similar technologies.

- Working knowledge of:

- Data governance

- Semantic layer concepts

- FAIR principles

- Modern data architecture patterns

- Experience working within Agile product development environments.

- Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Nice to Have
- Master's degree in Engineering, Data Science, Business, or a related field.

- Experience within Pharma, Biotechnology, Financial Services, Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG), or Management Consulting.

- Familiarity with Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), Omnichannel Marketing, or Digital Marketing Analytics.

- Demonstrated experience using product usage metrics and customer insights to prioritize roadmap investments.

- Experience working with enterprise-scale data products serving multiple business units or external clients.
Salary Range
- $130,000 - $160,000 (CAD)

jobs.title: Principal Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
About ShyftLabs

ShyftLabs is a data products and services company that partners with Fortune 500 organizations to solve complex business challenges through digital, data, and AI-driven solutions. We combine deep technical expertise with a consulting mindset to build scalable, enterprise-grade platforms and products that drive measurable business impact.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Principal Technical Product Manager to lead the strategy, roadmap, and execution of complex, technically sophisticated products and platforms.

This is a highly collaborative and hands-on role at the intersection of product, engineering, data, AI, and business strategy . You will translate ambiguous business and client needs into clear product direction while working closely with engineering and architecture teams to make informed technical and product trade-offs.

You will partner directly with Fortune 500 clients and internal technical leaders across cloud, data, and AI initiatives. The ideal candidate is comfortable operating at both the strategic and technical levels, able to define product vision and business outcomes while engaging deeply with engineers and architects on architecture, APIs, data, and delivery.
What You'll Do
Product Strategy & Ownership

-
Own the end-to-end product strategy, vision, roadmap, and execution for one or more technical product lines.

-
Lead products through the full lifecycle, from discovery and problem definition through development, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

-
Translate business objectives, customer needs, and technical capabilities into clear product requirements, user stories, and prioritized backlogs.

-
Define product goals, KPIs, and success metrics to measure adoption, performance, and business impact.

-
Make informed prioritization decisions and balance business value, technical complexity, customer needs, and delivery timelines.

Technical Product Leadership

-
Partner closely with engineering, architecture, data, and AI/ML teams to assess feasibility, sequence delivery, and resolve technical trade-offs.

-
Maintain a strong understanding of underlying technical architecture, including cloud platforms, APIs, data platforms, integrations, and AI/ML systems.

-
Participate in technical design discussions and confidently communicate with engineers and architects without requiring technical translation.

-
Drive build-vs-buy decisions and help evaluate technologies, platforms, vendors, and technical approaches.

-
Identify technical risks, dependencies, and opportunities early and work cross-functionally to address them.

Client & Stakeholder Leadership

-
Serve as a senior product leader and primary product point of contact for Fortune 500 clients and stakeholders.

-
Lead discovery sessions, product workshops, roadmap discussions, and executive presentations.

-
Translate complex technical concepts into clear business outcomes for executive and non-technical stakeholders.

-
Build alignment across clients, engineering teams, delivery teams, and internal leadership.

-
Manage competing priorities, expectations, scope, and timelines across multiple stakeholders.

Delivery & Team Leadership

-
Lead cross-functional product planning and delivery across distributed teams, including teams in Toronto and India.

-
Partner with engineering leadership to establish realistic delivery plans and ensure products are delivered against agreed objectives.

-
Remove roadblocks, manage dependencies, and maintain momentum in a fast-moving consulting and delivery environment.

-
Mentor and support junior Product Managers and Product Analysts as the team grows.

-
Establish and continuously improve product management practices, processes, and standards.
What You'll Bring 
-
8+ years of product management experience , including significant experience in technical, platform, data, or enterprise product management.

-
Proven experience owning the strategy and roadmap for data-intensive, cloud-based, AI/ML, or technically complex products .

-
Strong technical fluency with the ability to understand architecture diagrams, APIs, data contracts, integrations, and system dependencies.

-
Demonstrated experience partnering directly with enterprise or Fortune 500 clients , preferably within a consulting, technology services, or product-services environment.

-
Proven ability to take complex and ambiguous problems from discovery through production and measurable business outcomes.

-
Strong understanding of modern software development and product delivery methodologies.

-
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to adapt between technical discussions with engineers and strategic conversations with executives.

-
Experience leading products and roadmaps across distributed, cross-functional, and cross-time-zone teams.

-
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a data-driven approach to prioritization and decision-making.

-
A bias toward action and ownership, with the ability to make sound decisions in environments where requirements and priorities are constantly evolving.

-
Ability to operate comfortably at both the strategic and execution levels .
Nice to Have
-
Experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, or Apache Spark .

-
Experience working with cloud platforms such as GCP, AWS, or Azure .

-
Experience building or managing AI/LLM-powered products , including RAG, agentic workflows, or AI-powered automation.

-
Background in data products, analytics platforms, enterprise SaaS, or digital transformation.

-
Familiarity with APIs, microservices, event-driven architectures, and modern application platforms.

-
Experience working with enterprise architecture, governance, compliance, security, or InfoSec review processes.

-
Experience working with emerging AI technologies and frameworks, including MCP-style architectures.
Salary Range
- $130,000 - $160,000 (CAD)

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
About ShyftLabs
ShyftLabs is a fast-growing data and technology company that partners with Fortune 500 and enterprise organizations to solve complex business challenges through cloud, AI, data engineering, and modern software solutions. We foster a collaborative, innovation-driven culture where talented professionals work on impactful initiatives that drive measurable business outcomes.
The Opportunity
ShyftLabs is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Program Manager – Cybersecurity to support one of our leading enterprise clients. In this role, you will lead the delivery of large-scale cybersecurity programs that strengthen enterprise security capabilities while partnering with cross-functional engineering, security, and business teams.
This is an opportunity to work on high-impact initiatives within a complex enterprise environment, helping drive strategic security programs from planning through execution. The ideal candidate is a strong technical program leader who thrives in fast-paced environments, excels at managing multiple stakeholders, and is comfortable balancing Agile and traditional project delivery methodologies.

What You'll Be Doing
- Lead the end-to-end delivery of complex cybersecurity and technology programs, ensuring initiatives are completed on time, within scope, and aligned with business objectives.

- Manage project plans, timelines, dependencies, risks, resource allocation, and stakeholder communications across multiple concurrent initiatives.

- Drive Agile delivery by serving as a Scrum Master or Agile lead, facilitating ceremonies, managing backlogs, and coaching teams on Agile best practices.

- Partner with engineering, cybersecurity, infrastructure, compliance, and business stakeholders to translate technical requirements into actionable delivery plans.

- Monitor program health through delivery metrics, risk management, milestone tracking, and executive reporting, providing leadership with clear visibility into progress and key decisions.

- Identify and resolve cross-functional dependencies, risks, and roadblocks while fostering collaboration across technical and business teams.

- Apply Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid delivery methodologies based on program requirements and organizational needs.
What You'll Bring
- 5+ years of experience managing large-scale technical programs or projects within enterprise environments.

- Proven experience leading cross-functional engineering or technology initiatives.

- Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies, including experience serving as a Scrum Master or Agile Delivery Lead.

- Experience delivering projects using Agile, Waterfall, and hybrid methodologies.

- Demonstrated success managing complex dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.

- Experience with project management and collaboration tools such as Jira and Confluence.

- Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and executive presentation skills.

- Strong organizational, planning, and problem-solving abilities.

- PMP, Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or an equivalent project management certification.
Nice to Have
- Experience delivering enterprise cybersecurity or information security programs.

- Familiarity with Application Security, Security Operations, Identity & Access Management (IAM), Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC), and Privacy.

- Understanding of modern security practices, including Secure SDLC, vulnerability management, threat modeling, Zero Trust, and regulatory compliance frameworks.

- Experience integrating security tooling and automated testing into CI/CD pipelines.

- Experience working within enterprise PMOs or large-scale program governance environments.

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
Salary Range
$120,000 - $140,000 (CAD)
At ShyftLabs, your work matters. We’re a growing data product company making a big impact with Fortune 500 clients and as we scale, you’ll have the chance to shape solutions, influence strategy, and grow your career alongside us.
 
Here’s what you can expect when you join our team:
-Hybrid Flexibility: Enjoy a hybrid model with three days per week in our Toronto office.
-Downtown Toronto Office: Work in the heart of the city.
-Comprehensive Benefits: We cover 100% of health, dental, and vision insurance premiums for you and your dependents which means no out-of-pocket costs. Eligibility starts from day one itself.
-Growth & Learning: Access extensive learning and development resources to keep leveling up your skills.
 
Inclusion at ShyftLabs
 
We’re building something big, and we want you on the journey with us. If you’re ready to use data and innovation to make an impact, apply today and let’s grow together.
 
ShyftLabs is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a safe, diverse, and inclusive environment. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds including ethnicity, religion, disability status, gender identity, sexual orientation, family status, age, and nationality to apply. If you require accommodation during the interview process, let us know and we’ll be happy to support you.

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT SHYFTLABS

ShyftLabs is a data and AI company. Since 2020 we've partnered with Fortune 500 organizations across retail, healthcare, finance, energy, and the public sector to turn messy enterprise data into systems that actually move the business. Our team of 200+ builds privacy-first AI, modern data infrastructure, and analytics products that have unlocked hundreds of millions in measurable value for our clients.

We're scaling quickly, and we hire people who'd rather ship something real than write another deck about it.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We're looking for a Technical Product Manager to own a portfolio of data and AI products and take Product from problem definition through launch and iteration. You'll sit between enterprise clients, engineering, and data science, translating ambiguous business problems into clear product bets, then driving them to delivery.

This is a hands-on role at a company where the products are technical and the customers are demanding. You'll spend as much time in discovery conversations with client stakeholders as you do in backlog refinement with engineers. If you like owning outcomes rather than tickets, and you're comfortable being the person accountable when a launch either works or doesn't, this is a good fit.

This role is based in Toronto and follows a hybrid schedule, with three days per week in our downtown office.
What You'll Be Doing
-
Own the roadmap for one or more data and AI product lines — you set priorities, you defend the trade-offs, and you're accountable for the results.

-
Run discovery directly with enterprise clients and internal stakeholders to identify high-value problems worth solving, and separate them from the noise.

-
Write clear, decision-ready product requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, data contracts, edge cases, and what “done” actually means.

-
Partner day-to-day with engineering, data engineering, and design to sequence delivery, unblock decisions quickly, and keep scope honest.

-
Define success metrics up front, adoption, data quality, time-to-insight, model reliability, cost per outcome, and instrument products so those metrics are observable after launch.

-
Lead sprint ceremonies alongside engineering leads and keep delivery predictable without turning the team into a ticket factory.

-
Turn client feedback, usage data, and support signals into a prioritized backlog of improvements rather than a list of one-off requests.

-
Manage launches end to end: rollout plans, enablement material, internal training, and post-launch review.

-
Communicate roadmap status, risks, and trade-offs clearly to senior stakeholders on both the client and ShyftLabs sides.

-
Contribute to how we do product here, our discovery practices, prioritization frameworks, and delivery rituals are still being shaped, and we want your input on them.
What You'll Bring
-
3–6 years of product management experience, including at least 2 years shipping data, analytics, platform, or AI-powered products.

-
A track record of taking products from problem statement to production, not just maintaining an existing backlog.

-
Strong technical fluency: you can hold your own in an architecture discussion, read a data model, reason about APIs and integrations, and understand why a pipeline decision has downstream consequences.

-
Comfort working with enterprise stakeholders, including the ability to push back constructively on a request that isn't the right thing to build.

-
Analytical rigour, you use data to frame decisions and you're honest about what the data doesn't tell you.

-
Experience with Agile delivery and modern product tooling (Jira, Confluence, Figma, or equivalents).

-
Excellent written communication. Much of the job is writing things down clearly enough that people can act on them.

-
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Nice to Have
-
Background in retail, commerce media, or retail media networks.

-
Familiarity with LLM-based products: RAG, prompt orchestration, tool calling, evaluation frameworks, and guardrails.

-
Working knowledge of cloud data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, or BigQuery, and how they shape product constraints.

-
SQL skills sufficient to answer your own questions without waiting on someone else.

-
Prior experience in a startup or client-facing product environment.
Salary Range
- $130,000 - $160,000 (CAD)
